column1: # The grammar of a "const:<value>" parameter source, as both parsers must read it.
# ParseConstantSource in wrapper_base.h and TryParseConstant in Parameter.cs are the
# same grammar in two languages, in two processes: the manager validates a hooks.toml
# before the install, the patcher reads patch_config.toml at runtime. Neither can call
# the other, so this file is what keeps them from drifting. A test on each side reads
# it, so a change to one parser that is not made to the other fails.
# A constant this file says is parsed but one parser rejects is an install that passes
# every check and then fails to hook.
# source<TAB>outcome<TAB>value   outcome is parsed, malformed or none; value only when parsed.
